title: </sub>  Record the fixture and effective review configuration
text:
</sub>  Record the fixture and effective review configuration

This output contract adds only the sweep record and cost fields to the existing benchmark summary, which currently has no fixture-version or effective-review-configuration identity; moreover, the copied original manifest retains the same `benchmarkId` as the extended fixture. Consequently, the generated files cannot substantiate AC8/AC9's requirements to record the fixture version and the prompt/inference configuration or prove that the two arms differed only by sweep mode. Add explicit version and configuration metadata (for example, a fixture version plus prompt/config fingerprint and inference parameters) to every run record and verify equality across paired arms.
